events.title: Demo releases today!
events.summary: A massive THANK YOU to all of the early players (more than 15.000!) and the playtesters (150+!) for giving a try to the game and helping me improve it.I’ve been working hard in the past few months, and today I’m excited to announce the release of the demo for Lurking! If you’ve played the early itch.io demo back then, give it another shot: It is now much bigger and more polished.Here’s what to expect:40mn of content vs 10-12mn in the early demoSurvival-horror gameplay mechanicsMany QoL features

events.title: Revealing Lurking steam page!
events.summary: Hey there!I'm Jerome, solo dev at Ctrl Freak and I'd like to present my upcoming game Lurking.Lurking is a first-person horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders.
